meta.label: Subhalo 488530
meta.n_galaxies_source: count of TNG50 MW/M31 host cutouts (snapshot 99)

conventions.V: V = c(lambda/lambda0 - 1) + v_sys (km/s); galaxy systemic at 0; positive = away from the observer
conventions.tau: tau_i(V) = k_tau N_i H(a_i, (V - V_i)/b_i)/b_i; k_tau = 1.4975e-15 f lam0[A] (cm^2 km/s); total tau = sum_i tau_i, F = exp(-tau)
conventions.b: b_i = sqrt(2 k T_i / m) with Trident's atomic mass; thermal only (b_turb = 0)
conventions.l_kpc: cell centre along the sightline from its midpoint (path of the kernel line integral, kpc)
conventions.logN_total: total log N = log10 sum_i N_i
conventions.F_intrinsic: exp(-tau) of the stored Trident spectrum, linearly interpolated onto the 1 km/s grid
conventions.fion: n(O VI) = (O/H)sun (Z/Zsun) n_H f_OVI(n_H, T), HM2012 (hm2012_ss_hr), z = 0; n(H I) = x_HI n_H with TNG's own x_HI

sources.web_line: the explorer's stored sightline binary for rand_b062_a062 (S9 to S11 degrade it)

library.note: tngsight.vpfit on the noiseless native spectrum (the explorer's catalogue fit)
tngsight.vpfit on the noiseless native spectrum (the explorer's catalogue fit)

S6_pair.rule: O VI cells with tau0 > 0.05, |dV| < 0.5 min(b), |dl| >= 50 kpc; maximise (min tau0, max tau0)

S10_feature.rule: weakest local maximum (±3 km/s) of the O VI truth tau on the 1 km/s grid with tau >= 0.05

rules.S4a_cell: H I cell with the largest N
rules.S4b_cell: O VI cell with the largest N (also S5)

feature.rule: weakest local maximum (±3 km/s) of the O VI truth tau on the 1 km/s grid with tau >= 0.05

ray.note: disk frame (xhat, yhat, Lhat) kpc from the galaxy centre, the frame of the explorer cubes; point(l) = p0 + (l + half) n

kernel_cdf.interp: bilinear on the linear (q, u) grid; q = d/h clipped to [0, 1], u = (s - lc)/c clipped to [-1, 1], c = sqrt(h^2 - d^2); W_i(s) = table(q_i, u_i); tau(v; s) = sum_i W_i(s) tau_i(v)
kernel_cdf.kernel: yt cubic spline (yt arepo frontend: h = 2 (3V/4pi)^(1/3)); yt's ray dl_i = I(q_i^2) V_i/h_i^2

conventions.lc: kernel centre projected on the ray, l = s - half (kpc; 0 at the ray midpoint = closest approach); exact yt ray l. Use lc, s_in, s_out for every position along the ray
conventions.l_kpc_v1: ions.*.cells.l_kpc (v1) is yt l + dl/2 - half, offset from lc by up to 3.2 kpc; kept for v1 compatibility only
conventions.d: impact parameter of the generator from the ray (kpc)
conventions.crossed: ray cells whose Voronoi polyhedron the ray actually crosses (nearest generator every 5 pc); the rest only touch the ray with their kernel

fields.levels_note: l range of the story ray inside each cube level (null = never enters)

cloud_names.rule: clouds with >= 0.5 of their on-ray column (kernel centres) inside the letter's beat window; others are '<ion> structure'

enc.record: 14 B little endian, packed: u2x3 ray-frame position (l, up, side) = lo + q/65535*span (kpc; l along the ray, 0 at its midpoint; up/side along ray.frame), u1 log10 n_H cm^-3 ((x/255)*8 - 7), u1 log10 T K ((x/255)*5 + 3), u1 log10 Z/Zsun ((x/255)*4 - 3; Zsun = 0.0127, the explorer cubes convention), u1 log10 r_eq kpc ((x/255)*3.5 - 2; kernel h = 2 r_eq), u1 log10 n_HI cm^-3 ((x/255)*16 - 16), u1 log10 n_OVI cm^-3 ((x/255)*16 - 16), u1 cloud ids (low nibble H I cloud index + 1, high nibble O VI cloud index + 1; 0 = none, 15 = index >= 14), i1 V_los / 4 km/s (spectrum frame, galaxy systemic at 0; clipped at +-508)
enc.order: sorted by l; l_index[k] = first record with l >= l_index_l0 + k (1 kpc bins), last entry = n

facts2.b5_rule: depth of the O VI optical depth gained over B5, at its maximum

cold_knot.rule: H I cloud within 15 kpc of an O VI cloud with |dV| > 50 km/s (cloud V = its own spectral minimum); unlettered first, then largest N(H I); OVI_V lists every O VI cloud within the same distance

yt_partial_cuts.note: yt selects every particle with lc - h < l_cut (its sphere's extent along the ray, ignoring the impact parameter, so a few kernels that miss the segment are included) and keeps each with its full column; the story weights straddling cells by the kernel CDF, so it lies between the cells already left and the yt partial ray

flag_rules.has_first_ovi: some cell has O VI tau0 > 0.05
flag_rules.hi_black: an H I cloud's own peak tau > 1
flag_rules.has_ovi_skin: O VI cells (tau0 > 0.05) within 10 kpc of the black H I cloud (cloud A when lettered) and |dV| < 20 km/s
flag_rules.has_hot_stretch: >= 40 kpc of consecutive cells, none visible (tau0 > 0.01) in O VI or H I, median T > 1e+06 K
flag_rules.has_cold_knot: an H I cloud within 15 kpc of an O VI cloud with |dV| > 50 km/s
flag_rules.has_pair: the v1 S6 pair rule finds a pair
flag_rules.has_invented: page fits hold the S11c invented component (b < b_O(30000 K)) and CREST says the cells claim < 25 % of its fitted depth (beta). copy.json's '< 5 % summed responsibility' is not met on 488530 by any reading (column share 6.4 %, beta 8.8 %): needs U_copy / science sign-off
flag_rules.lite: false for every exported story (story-lite has no story file)
flag_rules.richest_not_closest: the O VI cloud with the largest column does not contain l = 0
flag_rules.has_b9_new_dips: the B9 window gains at least one new O VI dip (facts2.b9_new_dips non-empty); proposed to U_copy as the `when` of B9's entry, which quotes {{b9_new_dips}}

keys.mw_compare: somewhat bigger than the Milky Way
keys.ovi_sat: is mostly unsaturated, and its deepest core is just starting to saturate

story.rule: O VI peak tau >= 2 (strong, near-black O VI dip for S7/S9); H I peak tau >= 5 (black core, S8); a real S6 pair; visible O VI cells (b range, S7); a broad single-cloud fit (b >= 2x the widest visible cell b) and an invented narrow cloud whose fit total is within 0.5 dex of the truth (S11)
